map.单位价格比较器是做什么的？: What does Unit Price Comparator do?
map.如何使用单位价格比较器？: How do I use Unit Price Comparator?
map.单位价格比较器适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Unit Price Comparator best for?
map.单位价格 = 总价 ÷ 数量（须先换算为同一计量单位）；比较倍数 = 高单价 ÷: Unit price = total price ÷ quantity (convert to the same unit first); comparison ratio = higher unit price ÷ lower unit price; sort by unit price ascending to pick the best deal directly; when comparing, unify the basis (per 100 g and per kg must be converted consistently), promo multi-pack price = total price ÷ total quantity, price with shipping = (total price + shipping) ÷ quantity; discount rate = (original unit price − current unit price) ÷ original unit price × 100%.
map.比较前把所有数量归一为同一基本单位（g、ml、L），kg=1000g、L=100: Before comparing, normalize all quantities to the same base unit (g, ml, L); kg=1000g, L=1000ml, otherwise they are not comparable.
map.注意「数量」是净重/净含量，而非包装重量；促销装、组合装需拆到单件再比。: Note that "quantity" is net weight/content, not package weight; for promo or combo packs, break down to single units before comparing.
map.临期、赠品、会员价等隐性因素本工具未计入，最终决策结合实际情况。: Hidden factors like near-expiry, freebies and member prices are not counted by this tool; make the final decision based on the actual situation.
map.购物比价：把不同规格（大包/小包、不同单位）的商品折算到同一单价再比。: Shopping comparison: convert items of different specs (large/small packs, different units) to the same unit price before comparing.
map.采购决策：同品质下选每单位更低的规格，识别「看起来便宜其实贵」。: Procurement decisions: at the same quality, pick the spec with the lower per-unit price, spotting "looks cheap but is actually pricey".
map.促销识别：判断「第二件半价」「买赠」后的真实单价。: Promo detection: judge the real unit price after "second item half price" or "buy and get free".
map.A：500g 卖 15 元 → 0.03 元/g；B：300g 卖 12 元 →: A: 500g for ¥15 → ¥0.03/g; B: 300g for ¥12 → ¥0.04/g. After conversion A has the lower unit price; though its total is higher, it is the better deal. If you only need a little, pick B to avoid waste.
map.单位不统一怎么比？: How to compare with mixed units?
map.先统一单位（元/克、元/升、元/个），再比单价；按「每 100g」或「每 100: First unify the unit (¥/g, ¥/L, ¥/each), then compare unit prices; converting by "per 100g" or "per 100ml" is most intuitive, avoiding mixing kg and g.
map.净重和毛重有区别吗？: Is there a difference between net and gross weight?
map.有。带包装食品应按净含量算，否则含包装的「单价」虚低；液体注意是否含瓶重，按标注: Yes. Packaged food should be priced by net content; otherwise the "unit price" including packaging is falsely low. For liquids mind the bottle weight; use the labeled net content.
